title.zh: 将八打雁省马尔瓦尔市镇圣安德烈斯描笼涯San Andres小学的名称变更为Miguel Aranda纪念小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the San Andres Elementary School in Barangay San Andres, Municipality of Malvar, Province of Batangas, to Miguel Aranda Memorial Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the San Andres Elementary School in Barangay San Andres, Municipality of Malvar, Province of Batangas, to Miguel Aranda Memorial Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học San Andres tại Barangay San Andres, Thị trấn Malvar, Tỉnh Batangas thành Trường tiểu học Miguel Aranda Memorial
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา San Andres ในบารังไกย์ San Andres, เทศบาล Malvar, จังหวัด Batangas เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Miguel Aranda Memorial
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar San Andres di Barangay San Andres, Kotamadya Malvar, Provinsi Batangas menjadi Sekolah Dasar Miguel Aranda Memorial
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah San Andres di Barangay San Andres, Perbandaran Malvar, Wilayah Batangas menjadi Sekolah Rendah Miguel Aranda Memorial

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6719_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of San Andres Elementary School in Barangay San Andres, Municipality of Malvar, Province of Batangas, is hereby changed to Miguel Aranda Memorial Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
